title: tracker.census v1 payload
description: GET /api/v1/tracker/{project}?mode=census response body (ENC-TSK-Q14 O2.4). See governance_data_dictionary.json tracker.census for full field semantics (D3-D6). Deliberately has NO `records` key -- this is a bounded summary, not a page of records.

count.description: Total matching records walked (primary + escalation, unless the escalation walk truncated -- D5).

count_truncated.description: True iff either walk's budget (D3) tripped before exhaustion -- CENSUS_MAX_RAW_PAGES or CENSUS_WALL_CLOCK_MS on the primary walk, or the escalation walk (D5).

exhausted.description: True iff the primary walk's final DynamoDB call had no LastEvaluatedKey.

pages.description: Page anchors (O2.2) sliced from the primary walk's rows at page_size, never re-queried.

cursor.description: O1.1 _encode_list_cursor encoding of the last row of the PRECEDING page; null for page 0.

started_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp captured at walk start (D4).

max_updated_at.description: Maximum updated_at observed across every primary-walk row; empty string when zero rows were walked.

order.description: D6: 'record_id_asc' on the untyped base-table branch, 'unspecified' on the typed project-type-index GSI branch.

by_type.description: Per-record-type counts. Keys are a subset of task/issue/feature/plan/lesson/escalation depending on the type filter and whether the escalation walk ran/completed.

ids.description: Present iff count <= ids_inline_cap. Full list of primary-walk record ids -- never a partial/truncated list.

excluded_types.description: Present only when the escalation second walk (D5) truncated before exhaustion; escalation rows are then excluded from count/by_type/pages.
